methodologyNotes: Roster covers eleven electric recovery winches (9,500-12,500 lb class, plus one legacy 8,000 lb worm/spur-gear military-pattern winch) and one genuine winch accessory, verified 2026-08-09 against manufacturer product pages (WARN, Smittybilt, Superwinch, Harbor Freight/Badland, ComeUp, X-BULL, Champion Power Equipment) where reachable, corroborated by authorized dealers and retailers (Winches Inc., eTrailer, OK4WD, Ultra Pickleball, Nomadic Supply, Summit Racing) when the manufacturer's own page did not expose a field or blocked automated access. Fields left null (rather than guessed) where no source stated them: WARN VR EVO 10-S and Zeon 10-S motor horsepower and weight (WARN's own pages state only rope/gear-ratio/IP data, not HP or shipping weight); Zeon 10-S gear ratio and clutch type; Tiger Shark 9500 and Champion 11,000 lb IP rating; M8274-50 and Nautic 12,500 gear ratio; Viper 12000 motor HP and weight; Nautic 12,500 line length/diameter, clutch, remote, weight and price (product appears discontinued/renamed - see below); Champion 11,000 lb price (not published, no consistent third-party figure found); M8274-50 price (see note). Three adversarial corrections were made to the seed list: (1) "VIPER Elite 12000" does not exist - MotoAlliance's "Viper Elite" trim is its UTV/ATV line, which tops out at 6,000 lb; the 12,000 lb truck/SUV recovery winch in MotoAlliance's lineup is sold simply as "Viper" (no Elite trim), so the entry was corrected to MotoAlliance Viper 12,000 lb Recovery Truck Winch. (2) "Champion 11500 lb" winch does not exist in Champion Power Equipment's catalog; their nearest and only comparable product is the 11,000 lb Winch Kit with Speed Mount (model 100139), used as the corrected entry. (3) "TRAC Outdoor Roller Fairlead" does not exist as an off-road product - TRAC Outdoors is a marine brand (anchor winches, boat pumps, anchor rollers for boat bow rollers) with no ATV/UTV/truck winch fairlead in its catalog; substituted with the genuine off-road-relevant accessory a buyer researching this category would actually want: WARN's OEM 4-way roller fairlead (part 5742) for truck/SUV winches over 4,000 lb. Separately, "Warn M8274-50" (part 38631) is a distinct, older worm/spur-gear 8,000 lb military-pattern winch design still sold alongside WARN's modern M8274 (part 106170, 10,000 lb, spur-gear, $3,212.99) - the two are easily confused since both current product-family pages reference "M8274"; the -50 suffix legacy unit was used per the seed's exact model string, and its own MSRP could not be independently confirmed (a reseller listing showing $3,212.99 discounted to $963.90 appears to reuse the modern M8274's list price rather than a verified -50-specific figure), so priceUsd is left null. accessedAt 2026-08-09 throughout. Rugged Ridge's Nautic winch line (part 15100.22, 12,500 lb) shows signs of discontinuation/rebrand - Rugged Ridge's current site markets an apparently successor product as the "Trekker" winch line at the same 12,500 lb capacity - so pricing and several fields for the Nautic entry could not be freshly corroborated on a live manufacturer page and are sourced to retailer listings/search snippets instead.

products.name: WARN VR EVO 10-S Winch

specs.remote_type: 2-in-1 remote with wired and wireless controls

products.provenance: WARN's own VR EVO 10-S product page confirms 10,000 lb rated line pull, 90 ft of 3/8 in synthetic rope, 218:1 three-stage planetary gear ratio, IP68-rated waterproof construction, a series-wound 12V motor with automatic spring-brake freespool clutch, and a two-in-one wired/wireless remote, at $949.99 MSRP. WARN's page does not publish a motor horsepower figure or unit weight for this model, so both are left null rather than estimated.

products.name: WARN Zeon 10-S Winch
products.priceNote: Price as listed on warn.com's own Zeon 10-S product page; note this list price runs well above the VR EVO/X2O/Tiger Shark class, consistent with Zeon being WARN's premium standard-duty line

specs.remote_type: Wired remote with convertible control pack

products.provenance: WARN's own Zeon 10-S product page confirms 10,000 lb rated line pull, 100 ft of 3/8 in Spydura synthetic rope, full IP68 waterproofing, a planetary gear drive, a hawse fairlead, up to 33 ft/min no-load line speed, and a wired remote with convertible control pack, at $1,713.59. The page's specifications section does not surface a motor horsepower rating, numeric gear ratio, clutch mechanism name, or unit weight, so those fields are left null rather than assumed by analogy to other Zeon-series models.

products.priceNote: Current price on smittybilt.com's own product page
products.provenance: Smittybilt's own X2O Gen 2 product page confirms a 6.6 hp series-wound motor, 10,000 lb single-line capacity, 98.5 ft of 3/8 in synthetic rope, 218:1 three-stage planetary gear system with sliding ring gear clutch and automatic out-of-drum brake, IP68 rating, 67.0 lb winch weight, a 12 ft remote switch lead, and $799.99 price, backed by a lifetime mechanical / 5-year electrical warranty.

products.priceNote: Sale price on superwinch.com's own product page; regular price listed as $830.00

products.name: WARN M8274-50 Winch
products.priceNote: No verified manufacturer-published MSRP found specific to the -50 legacy unit (part 38631); a reseller listing shows $3,212.99 discounted to $963.90, but that figure is identical to WARN's current, structurally different M8274 (part 106170, 10,000 lb spur-gear model, $3,212.99 MSRP on warn.com) and appears to be reused/conflated rather than -50-specific, so left null rather than guessed
products.provenance: WARN's classic M8274-50 (part 38631) is a distinct, older worm/spur-gear military-pattern winch still sold alongside WARN's modern M8274 (part 106170); the two are easily confused since both current WARN pages reference "M8274" family naming. Winches Inc's authorized-dealer spec sheet reproduces WARN's own published data for the -50: 8,000 lb single-line rated capacity, spur gear train, 150 ft of 5/16 in steel cable, 4.6 hp (12V) / 2.5 hp (24V) series-wound motor, sliding-motor-pinion-gear freespooling clutch, 12 ft remote switch lead, 79.3 ft/min no-load retrieval speed, automatic disc brake, and 110 lb weight. No numeric gear ratio or IP ingress rating is published for this legacy design, so both are left null rather than estimated. WARN's own M8274-50 manual (ManualsLib-hosted) was consulted but its OCR text was not legible enough to independently corroborate gear ratio.

products.name: BADLAND ZXR 12,000 lb Truck/SUV Winch with Wire Rope
products.priceNote: Harbor Freight coupon/sale price; regular listed price $657.51

products.name: Rugged Ridge Nautic Winch, 12,500 lb, Steel Cable, Waterproof (15100.22)
products.priceNote: No consistently verifiable current retail price found across dealer listings at time of research; several retailers show the product as discontinued/out of stock
products.provenance: Rugged Ridge's Nautic line (part 15100.22, steel cable variant; 15100.23/15100.25 are synthetic-rope siblings) is documented consistently across authorized dealers (4wdparts.com, bbwheelsonline.com, Quadratec) as a 12,500 lb capacity winch with a 6.6 hp series-wound motor, X-braced gearbox housing, and IP67 waterproof rating. Rugged Ridge's own current site appears to market an apparent successor product at the same 12,500 lb capacity under the "Trekker" name, and Offroad Warehouse lists the Nautic 12500 explicitly as discontinued ("TBD" pricing) - consistent with a line transition rather than a live, freshly-priced SKU. Line length/diameter, clutch type, remote type, weight, and price were not corroborated on any live, fetchable source and are left null rather than guessed.

products.name: ComeUp Seal Gen2 9.5rs Winch
products.priceNote: OK4WD authorized-dealer sale price; ComeUp-cited MSRP is $1,460.00. ComeUp does not sell direct or publish consumer pricing on comeupwinch.com.

specs.remote_type: Dual: built-in digital wireless remote + waterproof corded remote (17 ft cord)

products.provenance: ComeUp's own product page and the model's ManualsLib-hosted operator's manual confirm 4,309 kg / 9,500 lb single-line synthetic-rope rated pull, a 3,730 W / 5.0 hp 12V DC series-wound motor with thermal protection, 10 mm x 30.5 m (3/8 in x 100 ft) synthetic rope, a 159:1 three-stage planetary gear ratio, rotating-ring-gear freespooling clutch, an automatic full-load Cone Brake Structure (CBS) mounted outside the drum, dual wireless/corded remote control, and 28.5 kg / 62.8 lb winch-only weight (40 kg / 88 lb gross shipping weight). Note: a differently-configured product also sold under the "Seal Gen2" name (CU295660, 16,500 lb line pull / 11,000 lb vehicle-recovery rating, 1/2 in rope, IP68) exists at a higher capacity tier and should not be confused with this 9.5rs (9,500 lb) entry.

products.name: MotoAlliance Viper 12,000 lb Recovery Truck Winch
products.priceNote: Retailer (Ultra Pickleball, an authorized MotoAlliance dealer) listed price; motoalliance.com itself could not be fetched directly to confirm MSRP

specs.remote_type: Wireless remote switch + 11 ft tethered wired remote

products.provenance: CORRECTED FROM SEED: "VIPER Elite 12000" does not exist in MotoAlliance's actual lineup - "Viper Elite" is the brand's UTV/ATV winch trim, which tops out at 6,000 lb (confirmed on retailer pages showing Viper Elite offered only in 3,000-6,000 lb pull ratings). Retailer spec data (corroborated across an authorized-dealer listing and 802offroad's separate "VIPER 12,000lb Recovery 4x4 Truck Winch" listing) confirms 12,000 lb capacity, 3/8 in x 85 ft steel cable, 265:1 three-stage planetary gear ratio, IP67 waterproof rating, sliding ring gear clutch, automatic in-the-drum brake, integrated contactor/solenoid, included roller fairlead, 10 in x 4.5 in mount pattern, wireless remote plus an 11 ft wired backup remote, and a limited lifetime warranty, at $349.99. Motor horsepower and weight are not stated on any fetched source, so both are left null.

products.name: WARN Roller Fairlead, 4-Way (Part 5742)
products.priceNote: Nomadic Supply (authorized WARN parts dealer) listed price; special-order item, non-cancelable once ordered per manufacturer policy

specs.compatible_winch_capacity: WARN truck winches over 4,000 lb capacity (except M15 and 16.5ti)

products.provenance: CORRECTED FROM SEED: "TRAC Outdoor Roller Fairlead" does not exist as an off-road product - TRAC Outdoors (confirmed via its own distributor listings) is strictly a marine brand making anchor winches, bilge/oil-change pumps, anchor rollers for boat bow rollers, and related boating accessories, with no ATV/UTV/truck winch fairlead in its catalog. Substituted with the genuine off-road-relevant accessory a buyer researching this category would actually want: WARN's OEM four-roller fairlead, part 5742, an official WARN replacement/upgrade part for truck and SUV winches rated above 4,000 lb (excluding the M15 and 16.5ti). Nomadic Supply's authorized-dealer listing confirms zinc-plated steel construction, 11.7 lb weight, 12.5 in x 5.5 in x 4.0 in dimensions, UPC 012748057420, and $193.74 price; a separate listing (Summit Racing, part WRN-5742) shows the same part at $179.99, indicating some retailer price variance for this special-order component. This entry is an accessory, not a standalone winch, so winch-specific spec fields (pulling capacity, motor, line, gear ratio, IP rating, clutch, remote) are not applicable and left null.
